تصطلحون (form VIII)
# تَصْطَلِحُونَ (taṣṭaliḥūna) /tasˤ.tˤa.li.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
# تُصْطَلَحُونَ (tuṣṭalaḥūna) /tusˤ.tˤa.la.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَلَحَ (iṣṭalaḥa)
